title: ProCybernetica ControlNode registry
description: Closes ADR-0002 (Governed Cognition as an Emergent Functor) §8 GAP-3 / prophet-workspace#85, L2 (Fractal Control Fabric). ADR-0002's Layer 2 names 11 control-node types and states that repos, agents, services, gateways, and hosts are 'treated as lawful control nodes' — but they were prose, not a typed, enforceable set. This contract makes the 11 first-class as a CLOSED enum and binds each lawful control node to (a) exactly one of the 11 node_type control functions, (b) the concrete estate resource it governs (repo/agent/service/gateway/host), and (c) its lawful-promotion obligations (which membrane gates the resource must cross to act). The 11 types are the canonical set enumerated in docs/ORIENTATION_FOR_ENGINEERS.md and ADR-0002 L2; this schema does not fork the rich NodeDescriptor (node_descriptor.schema.json) — a ControlNode may point at a full descriptor via descriptor_ref. A resource may embody more than one control function (e.g. a receipt-gateway is both Observability and Execution) as separate ControlNode records over the same resource.ref; what is forbidden is the SAME control function claimed twice for one resource (enforced cross-record by tools/cybernetic_governance/validate_control_node.py).

node_id.description: Lawful identity of this control node. Unique across the registry (duplicate identity is rejected — see validate_control_node.py CN-T4).

node_type.description: The control function this node performs. CLOSED enum of the 11 ProCybernetica Fractal-Control-Fabric control-node types (ADR-0002 L2; docs/ORIENTATION_FOR_ENGINEERS.md). PascalCase tokens map to the prose names: WorldModel='World Model', ValueJudgment='Value Judgment', BehaviorGeneration='Behavior Generation'.

resource.description: The concrete estate resource this node governs. ADR-0002 L2: 'repos/agents/services/gateways/hosts are treated as lawful control nodes.'

ref.description: Stable reference to the resource, e.g. 'agent-registry' (repo), 'prophet-platform/apps/receipt-gateway' (service/gateway).

obligations.description: Lawful-promotion obligations: which governance-membrane gates (ADR-0002 L3) this node's resource MUST cross to take a state-changing action. A control node that governs a resource with no declared obligation is rejected (CN-T3) — no lawful control node may act ungated.

membrane_gates.description: CLOSED enum of the estate's real membrane gates (ADR-0002 L3/§7). An obligation naming a gate that does not exist is rejected (CN-T6).

node_class.description: Optional cross-reference to the NodeDescriptor node_class of the governed resource (node_descriptor.schema.json). Consume-not-fork: kept in lockstep with that enum.

descriptor_ref.description: Optional node_id of the full ProCybernetica NodeDescriptor for this resource (node_descriptor.schema.json). This contract deliberately stays thin and does not duplicate the descriptor's constitutional blocks.
